verdict.rationale: VPM's own registered-agent service receives service of process, legal notices and state correspondence, scans it the same day, and sends real-time email alerts, so that legal and state mail is separated and surfaced quickly. There is no evidence that IRS or other government mail arriving in the regular mailbox is automatically detected, flagged or prioritized. The generic automation rules and tagging are not shown to classify government or legal mail. Missing for 10: automatic detection and flagging of IRS/government mail in the general mailbox, a documented priority queue or deadline tracking, rules that target government/legal senders, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an operator, government and legal mail — IRS, state filings, service of process — is flagged or prioritized so a compliance deadline never sits unread in the pile

citations.quote: As your registered agent, VPM will receive service of process, legal notices, and other important state correspondences on your behalf.
All legal documents served are scanned and available online the same day they are received so you have more time to respond.
